source_scope.scope: Historical implementation semantics, structured output, E2E gating and evaluation methodology. The already-fixed owner directive that Digital Retina is mandatory inside FRANK is explicitly excluded from novelty credit.

findings.claim: The public Retina API already normalized path/URL/raw bytes into a local image and returned a structured analysis object rather than only prose. The historical structured schema included description, scored concepts, object class/confidence/box, OCR text, faces/emotion, logos, screenshot flag, image dimensions, elapsed time, AI/art provenance, scene tags, captions, region captions, multilingual VQA, relational/painting text, dominant colors, places, fine objects, region attributes, caption-grounded concepts, composition and optional GoL-derived fields.
findings.current_implication: Do not collapse the mandatory Digital Retina into one narrative string. Define typed provenance-bound Clay VisualPercept subfields with per-field source/model/confidence and preserve the structured historical signal while removing implementation-specific prose coupling.

findings.claim: The implementation used staged conditional computation: OCR+face analysis in parallel, a specialized screenshot branch, and CLIP+YOLO+DINO in parallel for photos. It also added an early art/AI detector specifically to drop low-confidence YOLO detections before region captioning after a documented hallucination cascade.
findings.current_implication: Preserve staged/conditional percept computation and explicit gating, but expose gating decisions and ancestry as receipts so downstream FRANK can distinguish not-run, no-detection, rejected-as-low-confidence and successful-percept states.

findings.claim: The honest hard-set report records a concrete cascading hallucination: on a Kandinsky image YOLO hallucinated a bed and region-BLIP then generated an invented artist attribution from that phantom region. Across the 12-image hard set Region-BLIP fired on 6/12; the report says one case actively hurt and several others mixed correct detail with wrong base classes or captions.
findings.current_implication: Every derived visual claim must retain parent-evidence ancestry. A caption derived from a weak/rejected object detection cannot be promoted as independent evidence. Harness must include confidence/provenance propagation and causal-parent invalidation tests.

findings.claim: The final hard-set report labels CLIP-lenient coverage 94.6% at cosine threshold 0.20, while its own threshold sweep reports 66.3% at 0.22 and 1.4% at 0.30. The report explicitly says this lenient metric measures whether the vision encoder contains a weak visual signal, not whether Retina surfaces that concept in text for a downstream LLM.
findings.current_implication: Clay 0.1 must not equate latent encoder recognizability with FRANK-accessible semantic perception. Primary acceptance metric should score the typed VisualPercept actually delivered/reconstructed/used by FRANK, with threshold curves reported rather than a cherry-picked point.

findings.claim: FINAL_REPORT.md is internally version-inconsistent: its headline reports strict substring coverage 87.8% after gap-close and 44.8% pre-gap-close, but the explanatory section later still says the strict metric sits at 44.8% for the same images/phrases. The source therefore cannot support one unqualified strict number without consulting the machine artifacts/version lineage.
findings.current_implication: Evaluation claims need immutable run IDs, config/threshold hashes and machine-result refs. Narrative reports are projections, not canonical measurements. Stale prose must not overwrite newer run state.

findings.claim: freshset_coverage.json contains 32 images and 681 baseline phrases. Its stored totals are 492 strict and 630 lenient hits, corresponding to 72.246696% strict and 92.511013% lenient at threshold 0.20. From the per-image recorded wall times, Retina mean/median/max were approximately 25.87/26.69/35.67 seconds in that evaluation path. Category strict coverage ranged from about 63.55% abstract to 86.36% vehicle; the complex category had the lowest lenient aggregate at about 78.35%.
findings.current_implication: Reuse the fresh-set machine artifact and category stratification as historical baseline data, but re-run on current hardware/typed VisualPercept because the old latency and representation path are not current acceptance evidence.

findings.claim: tier3_e2e.py tested three distinct surfaces: browser demo rendering, authenticated API behavior with English/German question paths, and a negative gating case requiring region_captions=[] and vqa=[] on a simple image with a non-question hint. This is valuable because it tests both positive capability and absence of inappropriate subsystem firing.
findings.current_implication: Port the positive/negative gating pattern into H1/H2/H3: equivalent visual input must produce equivalent typed percepts and equivalent non-events, not merely similar final prose.

findings.claim: The historical E2E source contains an embedded live-looking development API credential literal. The credential value is intentionally not copied into this receipt.
findings.current_implication: Archive assimilation/training-corpus construction must include secret detection/redaction and credential revocation review. Executable historical sources are evidence, not automatically safe training text.

earned_work_mapping_candidate.mechanism_or_result: Executable structured multimodal percept pipeline, staged gating, positive/negative E2E suite, fresh-set machine evaluation and concrete hallucination/metric/provenance failure oracles provide direct ancestry for mandatory Digital Retina integration and differential testing.
earned_work_mapping_candidate.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: H1/H2/H3 must implement typed VisualPercept with provenance/confidence, reproduce positive and negative gating, prevent weak-parent hallucination promotion, and demonstrate current fresh-set results/latency. If the historical schemas/tests do not reduce implementation/search effort, remove the avoided-work credit.

progress_accounting.reason: A bounded historical implementation/evaluation shard is analyzed, but recursive Drive and cross-source atomic denominators are not frozen.
